The slide-authoring and copywriting guidance adapts ideas from:

- [oil-tone](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-tone), Copyright (c) 2026 oil-oil, MIT. See [license](oil-tone-LICENSE.txt).

Upstream license files were retrieved from the repositories during this integration. Relevant methods were rewritten and combined with WBY's presentation workflow. The bundled deck-management CLI is a separate implementation; neither upstream CLI nor tone linter is required or bundled.
